messages:
Cindy (LatticeAI): Hey team — completed SSO onboarding around 11:10am but no API key shows in our console. Our app calls to /v1/generate return 403, example below. Can you help?

Cindy (LatticeAI): curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-1"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"api_key_not_found","message":"no api key for tenant"}

sara_support: Sorry about that, Cindy. Can you paste the tenant_id or org slug you signed up with? Also, did you sign up through SSO (Okta) or just OIDC?

Cindy (LatticeAI): Org slug: latticeai.tenant_id: tid_7a9b2f. SSO via Okta (company SSO). We completed consent. Console shows "Provisioning complete" but no API key in the Keys tab.

miguel_devops: Looking at the provisioner logs for that timeframe (11:07–11:12). I see a key create event but it was bound to project_id=internal-tools-42, not the customer's project. The provisioner picked up claim.sub='okta|7a9b2f' but our matcher expected 'tenant:7a9b2f' — mapping mismatch.

sara_support: That would explain no key in their console. Is the key orphaned or visible in any internal project?

miguel_devops: It's visible in the internal-tools project as sk-live-7f9d but flagged as "customer-origin". We didn't reconcile the claim format for the new Okta connector patch.

ryan_oncall: deploy-bot just posted a release at 11:05 that updated the OIDC claim parser. @deploy-bot can you confirm commit?

deploy-bot: Release deployed: infra/provisioner v2026.02.11-7c9e1b — changed claim parsing behavior. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/commits/7c9e1b

sre_bot: We should avoid touching claim parsing without a rollback-safe mapping. Miguel, can you rebind the key or run a manual reconcile for tenant_id tid_7a9b2f?

miguel_devops: Will rebind. Quick repro steps I used:
1) grep provisioner logs for tid_7a9b2f
2) curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://internal.redwood.ai/provisioner/rebind -d '{"key":"sk-live-7f9d","tenant_id":"tid_7a9b2f","project_id":"latticeai-prod"}'
Response: {"status":"ok","rebinding":true}

sara_support: Cindy — if Miguel can rebind, will that restore your key in the console?

Cindy (LatticeAI): Yes please. We need it to go live today.

miguel_devops: Executed rebind at 11:26. Console now shows key sk-live-7f9d under latticeai-prod. Please try your call again.

Cindy (LatticeAI): Retried — now 200 OK, thanks! Response looks good.

alex_platform: Root cause: provisioner release changed the OIDC claim normalization. Short-term fix: manual rebind for affected tenants + create alert for claim mismatch rates. Long-term fix: make claim parser backwards-compatible and add a migration that normalizes existing mappings.

sre_bot: Filed infra ticket INFRA-1427 to backfill keys created since 2026-02-11 and to add reconciliation run.

ryan_oncall: Also added a temporary mitigation: if a key is created and no project claim match is found, create the key in a staging-holding project and open an automated task instead of defaulting to internal-tools.

sara_support: Marking this resolved for the user — manual action completed, customer validated. Following up with eng infra for the fix. Cindy, I'll DM you the newly bound key and close the support ticket after you confirm no further issues. :thumbsup:

Cindy (LatticeAI): Confirmed. Appreciate the quick help!
